hint: 0304.93 is not in the HS 2007 schedule. The WCO tables name part of HS 2007 0304.99 (ex 0304.99) as its source, through HS 2012. From 2022-04-04 the amended rule for 0304.99 is a change from materials of any other chapter (Japan Customs notice of 2022-03-23: 第０３０４．９９号の産品への他の類の材料からの変更). The link is partial and administrative, so it is not shown as the rule for 0304.93. A specialist needs to confirm the rule by product.
